args.summary: A configuration change in commit 0f782bf updated PAYMENTS_URL in config/api.env from port 8080 to 8443. Because the payments service does not listen on port 8443, all payment requests from the API service fail with connection refused errors (HTTP 500 on /checkout) immediately after the service restart at 15:28:56 UTC.

report.summary: A configuration change in commit 0f782bf updated PAYMENTS_URL in config/api.env from port 8080 to 8443. Because the payments service does not listen on port 8443, all payment requests from the API service fail with connection refused errors (HTTP 500 on /checkout) immediately after the service restart at 15:28:56 UTC.

truth.key_detail: PAYMENTS_URL in config/api.env was changed to http://payments:8443 by commit 0f782bf; the payment service listens on 8080, so every charge is refused
red_herrings: worker settings commit (batch size) deployed to the worker about nine minutes before the incident
truth.expected_fix: set PAYMENTS_URL back to http://payments:8080 and redeploy the api
truth.notes: Only POST /checkout fails. Each failed checkout logs two 'payment attempt failed, retrying' WARNINGs and then one ERROR; this recording has no such WARNING in the healthy period. The same commit also raises PAYMENTS_TIMEOUT_S from 3 to 5, which is harmless. The payment service's real port (8080) is visible in the old value in the culprit diff and in the stub's source.
